audience: online shop owners who run a Shoprenter web shop

useCases.title: Check incoming orders and their status
useCases.text: List the newest orders, filtered by creation or update time. Open one to read its totals, addresses and status labels.

useCases.title: Find products that are out of stock
useCases.text: List products with their stock flags and status. Read the stock status labels the shop uses for them.

useCases.title: Review new customers
useCases.text: List customers created or updated in a time window. Open one to read its group, status and addresses.

useCases.title: Review the catalog structure
useCases.text: List the product categories and manufacturers. Open one category to read its parent and status.
